claims.quote: Boeseman's rainbowfish, Melanotaenia boesemani, is a rainbowfish from Indonesia, known only from the Ajamaru lakes and nearby Lakes Hain and Aitinjo.
This species is found in mountain lakes and tributaries in West Papua, Indonesia.
